```diff
+ import {useEffect, useRef, useState} from 'react'
+ import gsap from 'gsap'
+ import Zdog from 'zdog'
+ 
+ interface AnimatedHudInterfaceProps {
+   className?: string
+ }
+ 
+ const AnimatedHudInterface = ({className = ''}: AnimatedHudInterfaceProps) =&gt; {
+   const [isInitialized, setIsInitialized] = useState(false)
+   const illoRef = useRef&lt;any&gt;(null)
+   const anchorRef = useRef&lt;any&gt;(null)
+   const animReqRef = useRef&lt;number | null&gt;(null)
+   const tlRef = useRef&lt;gsap.core.Timeline | null&gt;(null)
+ 
+   const setup = () =&gt; {
+     const crosslines = gsap.utils.toArray('line')
+     const circles = gsap.utils.toArray('circle')
+     const localData = gsap.utils.toArray('.local li')
+     const remoteData = gsap.utils.toArray('.remote li')
+     const btn = document.querySelector('button')
+ 
+     gsap.set('.blob', {opacity: 0})
+     gsap.set('.reticule', {opacity: 1, scale: 1})
+     gsap.set(['.local h3', '.remote h3'], {opacity: 0})
+     gsap.set('.cube', {opacity: 0})
+     gsap.set(btn, {opacity: 0})
+ 
+     gsap.set(['#retPath', '#reticuleText'], {clearProps: 'all'})
+ 
+     if (btn) {
+       btn.addEventListener('click', () =&gt; {
+         if (tlRef.current) tlRef.current.restart()
+       })
+     }
+ 
+     localData.forEach((item) =&gt; {
+       gsap.set(item, {
+         x: -20,
+         opacity: 0,
+       })
+     })
+ 
+     remoteData.forEach((item) =&gt; {
+       gsap.set(item, {
+         x: 20,
+         opacity: 0,
+       })
+     })
+ 
+     crosslines.forEach((line) =&gt; {
+       gsap.set(line, {
+         attr: {x2: 250, y2: 250},
+       })
+     })
+ 
+     circles.forEach((circle) =&gt; {
+       gsap.set(circle, {
+         attr: {r: 1},
+         opacity: 0,
+       })
+     })
+ 
+     gsap.set(['#tl polyline', '#tr polyline', '#br polyline', '#bl polyline'], {
+       attr: {
+         'stroke-dasharray': 60,
+         'stroke-dashoffset': 60,
+       },
+     })
+     gsap.set(['#tl text', '#tr text', '#br text', '#bl text'], {opacity: 0})
+ 
+     if (animReqRef.current) {
+       cancelAnimationFrame(animReqRef.current)
+       animReqRef.current = null
+     }
+   }
+ 
+   const showButton = () =&gt; {
+     gsap.to('button', 0.3, {opacity: 1})
+   }
+ 
+   const showCube = () =&gt; {
+     gsap.to('.cube', 0.5, {opacity: 1})
+ 
+     illoRef.current = new Zdog.Illustration({element: '.zdog-canvas'})
+     const TAU = Zdog.TAU
+ 
+     anchorRef.current = new Zdog.Anchor({
+       addTo: illoRef.current,
+       translate: {x: -15, y: -15},
+       rotate: {x: TAU / 3, y: TAU / 3},
+     })
+ 
+     new Zdog.Box({
+       addTo: anchorRef.current,
+       width: 60,
+       height: 60,
+       depth: 60,
+       stroke: 1,
+       fill: false,
+       color: '#E6E6E6',
+     })
+ 
+     animate()
+   }
+ 
+   const animate = () =&gt; {
+     if (anchorRef.current &amp;&amp; illoRef.current) {
+       anchorRef.current.rotate.y += 0.03
+       anchorRef.current.rotate.x += 0.03
+       illoRef.current.updateRenderGraph()
+       animReqRef.current = requestAnimationFrame(animate)
+     }
+   }
+ 
+   const showBlob = () =&gt; {
+     gsap.to('.blob', 5, {opacity: 1})
+   }
+ 
+   const interfaceDataAnim = () =&gt; {
+     gsap.to(['.local h3', '.remote h3'], 0.3, {
+       keyframes: {
+         opacity: [0, 1, 0, 1, 0, 1, 0, 1],
+       },
+     })
+ 
+     const localData = gsap.utils.toArray('.local li')
+     localData.forEach((item, i) =&gt; {
+       gsap.to(item, 0.6, {
+         x: 0,
+         opacity: 1,
+         delay: i * 0.2,
+       })
+     })
+ 
+     const remoteData = gsap.utils.toArray('.remote li')
+     remoteData.forEach((item, i) =&gt; {
+       gsap.to(item, 0.6, {
+         x: 0,
+         opacity: 1,
+         delay: i * 0.2,
+       })
+     })
+   }
+ 
+   const bannerAnim = () =&gt; {
+     gsap.to(['#tl polyline', '#tr polyline', '#br polyline', '#bl polyline'], 0.3, {
+       attr: {
+         'stroke-dasharray': 60,
+         'stroke-dashoffset': 0,
+       },
+     })
+ 
+     gsap.to(['#tl text', '#tr text', '#br text', '#bl text'], 0.3, {
+       keyframes: {
+         opacity: [0, 1, 0, 1, 0, 1, 0, 1],
+       },
+       delay: 0.2,
+     })
+   }
+ 
+   const reticuleAnim = () =&gt; {
+     gsap.to('#retPath', 0.1, {
+       opacity: 0.4,
+       repeat: 20,
+     })
+ 
+     gsap.to('#reticuleText', 0.1, {
+       opacity: 0.4,
+       repeat: 20,
+     })
+   }
+ 
+   const reticuleFade = () =&gt; {
+     gsap.to('.reticule', 0.5, {
+       opacity: 0,
+       scale: 0,
+       transformOrigin: '50% 50%',
+     })
+   }
+ 
+   const circlesAnim = () =&gt; {
+     const circles = gsap.utils.toArray('circle')
+     const tl = gsap.timeline({
+       ease: 'circ.inOut',
+       duration: 0.6,
+     })
+ 
+     tl.to(circles[0], {
+       attr: {r: 80},
+       opacity: 1,
+     }).to(
+       circles[1],
+       {
+         attr: {r: 80},
+         opacity: 1,
+       },
+       '-=0.2'
+     )
+ 
+     tl.to(
+       circles[2],
+       {
+         attr: {r: 80},
+         opacity: 1,
+       },
+       '-=0.4'
+     )
+   }
+ 
+   const crossLinesAnim = () =&gt; {
+     const crosslines = gsap.utils.toArray('line')
+     const dur = 0.7
+     const easing = 'circ.inOut'
+ 
+     gsap.to(crosslines[0], dur, {
+       attr: {x2: 100, y2: 100},
+       ease: easing,
+     })
+ 
+     gsap.to(crosslines[1], dur, {
+       attr: {x2: 400, y2: 100},
+       ease: easing,
+     })
+ 
+     gsap.to(crosslines[2], dur, {
+       attr: {x2: 400, y2: 400},
+       ease: easing,
+     })
+ 
+     gsap.to(crosslines[3], dur, {
+       attr: {x2: 100, y2: 400},
+       ease: easing,
+     })
+   }
+ 
+   const initTimeline = () =&gt; {
+     tlRef.current = gsap.timeline()
+ 
+     tlRef.current
+       .add(setup)
+       .add(reticuleAnim)
+       .add(reticuleFade, 2)
+       .add(circlesAnim, 1.5)
+       .add(crossLinesAnim, 2.5)
+       .add(bannerAnim, 3)
+       .add(interfaceDataAnim, 3.5)
+       .add(showBlob, 2.5)
+       .add(showCube, 3.8)
+       .add(showButton, 5)
+   }
+

+     if (!isInitialized) {
+       initTimeline()
+       setIsInitialized(true)
+     }
+ 
+     return () =&gt; {
+       if (animReqRef.current) {
+         cancelAnimationFrame(animReqRef.current)
+       }
+     }
+   }, [isInitialized])
+

+     if (tlRef.current) {
+       tlRef.current.restart()
+     }
+   }
```

```diff
+ import {useState, useEffect, useRef} from 'react'
+ 
+ interface TextScrambleEffectProps {
+   phrases?: string[]
+   interval?: number
+   className?: string
+ }
+ 
+ const TextScrambleEffect = ({
+   phrases = [
+     'Neo,',
+     'sooner or later',
+     "you're going to realize",
+     'just as I did',
+     "that there's a difference",
+     'between knowing the path',
+     'and walking the path',
+   ],
+   interval = 800,
+   className = '',
+ }: TextScrambleEffectProps) =&gt; {
+   const [output, setOutput] = useState('')
+   const [counter, setCounter] = useState(0)
+   const textRef = useRef&lt;HTMLDivElement&gt;(null)
+   const queueRef = useRef&lt;
+     Array&lt;{
+       from: string
+       to: string
+       start: number
+       end: number
+       char?: string
+     }&gt;
+   &gt;([])
+   const frameRef = useRef(0)
+   const frameRequestRef = useRef&lt;number | null&gt;(null)
+   const resolveRef = useRef&lt;() =&gt; void&gt;(() =&gt; {})
+ 
+   const chars = '!&lt;&gt;-_\\/[]{}—=+*^?#________'
+ 
+   const randomChar = () =&gt; {
+     return chars[Math.floor(Math.random() * chars.length)]
+   }
+ 
+   const update = () =&gt; {
+     let outputText = ''
+     let complete = 0
+     const queue = queueRef.current
+ 
+     for (let i = 0, n = queue.length; i &lt; n; i++) {
+       let {from, to, start, end, char} = queue[i]
+ 
+       if (frameRef.current &gt;= end) {
+         complete++
+         outputText += to
+       } else if (frameRef.current &gt;= start) {
+         if (!char || Math.random() &lt; 0.28) {
+           char = randomChar()
+           queue[i].char = char
+         }
+         outputText += &#96;&lt;span class="text-neutral-500"&gt;${char}&lt;/span&gt;&#96;
+       } else {
+         outputText += from
+       }
+     }
+ 
+     setOutput(outputText)
+ 
+     if (complete === queue.length) {
+       resolveRef.current()
+     } else {
+       frameRef.current++
+       frameRequestRef.current = requestAnimationFrame(update)
+     }
+   }
+ 
+   const setText = (newText: string) =&gt; {
+     const oldText = textRef.current?.innerText || ''
+     const length = Math.max(oldText.length, newText.length)
+     const promise = new Promise&lt;void&gt;((resolve) =&gt; {
+       resolveRef.current = resolve
+     })
+ 
+     const queue = []
+     for (let i = 0; i &lt; length; i++) {
+       const from = oldText[i] || ''
+       const to = newText[i] || ''
+       const start = Math.floor(Math.random() * 40)
+       const end = start + Math.floor(Math.random() * 40)
+       queue.push({from, to, start, end})
+     }
+ 
+     queueRef.current = queue
+ 
+     if (frameRequestRef.current) {
+       cancelAnimationFrame(frameRequestRef.current)
+     }
+ 
+     frameRef.current = 0
+     update()
+ 
+     return promise
+   }
+ 
+   const nextPhrase = () =&gt; {
+     setText(phrases[counter]).then(() =&gt; {
+       setTimeout(() =&gt; {
+         setCounter((prevCounter) =&gt; (prevCounter + 1) % phrases.length)
+       }, interval)
+     })
+   }
+ 
+   useEffect(() =&gt; {
+     nextPhrase()
+ 
+     return () =&gt; {
+       if (frameRequestRef.current) {
+         cancelAnimationFrame(frameRequestRef.current)
+       }
+     }
+   }, [counter])
+ 
+   return (
+     &lt;div className={&#96;flex justify-center items-center h-full ${className}&#96;}&gt;
+       &lt;div
+         ref={textRef}
+         className='font-mono font-thin text-2xl text-white'
+         dangerouslySetInnerHTML={{__html: output}}
+       /&gt;
+     &lt;/div&gt;
+   )
+ }
+ 
+ export default TextScrambleEffect
+ 
```

```diff
+ 
+ const CardsPlayerHolo = ({className = '', cardData = defaultCardData}: CardsPlayerHoloProps) =&gt; {
+   // State variables
+   const [activeIndex, setActiveIndex] = useState(0)
+   const [isAnimating, setIsAnimating] = useState(false)

+   const timelineRef = useRef&lt;HTMLDivElement&gt;(null)
+   const progressRef = useRef&lt;HTMLDivElement&gt;(null)
+   const handleRef = useRef&lt;HTMLDivElement&gt;(null)
+ 
+   // Format time in minutes:seconds
+   const formatTime = (seconds: number) =&gt; {
+     const minutes = Math.floor(seconds / 60)
+     const secs = Math.floor(seconds % 60)
+     return &#96;${minutes}:${secs.toString().padStart(2, '0')}&#96;
+   }
+ 
+   // Set music track based on active card
+   const setMusicTrack = (index: number) =&gt; {
+     const wasPlaying = isPlaying
+ 
+     if (audioRef.current) {
+       // Update music source
+       audioRef.current.src = cardData[index].music
+ 
+       // If it was playing before, start playing the new track
+       if (wasPlaying) {
+         audioRef.current
+           .play()
+           .then(() =&gt; {
+             setIsPlaying(true)
+           })
+           .catch((err) =&gt; {
+             console.error('Error playing audio:', err)
+             setIsPlaying(false)
+           })
+       }
+     }
+   }
+ 
+   // Update cards position
+   const updateCards = (animate = true) =&gt; {
+     if (isAnimating &amp;&amp; animate) return
+ 
+     if (animate) {
+       setIsAnimating(true)
+ 
+       // Change music track for the newly active card
+       setMusicTrack(activeIndex)
+     }
+ 
+     const cards = cardRefs.current
+     const totalCards = cards.length
+ 
+     // Apply positions
+     cards.forEach((card, index) =&gt; {
+       if (!card) return
+ 
+       // Calculate position based on distance from active card
+       const distance = index - activeIndex
+ 
+       // Position cards in a horizontal stack
+       let translateY, translateZ, translateX, scale, opacity
+ 
+       if (distance === 0) {
+         // Active card - at the front
+         translateY = 0
+         translateZ = 0
+         translateX = 0
+         scale = 1
+         opacity = 1
+       } else {
+         // Cards in stack - position them above the active card
+         translateY = -50 * Math.abs(distance) // Stack vertically
+         translateZ = -100 * Math.abs(distance) // Move back in 3D space
+         translateX = 0
+         scale = 1 - 0.05 * Math.abs(distance) // Slightly smaller
+         opacity = 1 - 0.15 * Math.abs(distance) // Slightly transparent
+       }

+       // Apply transform with animation if needed
+       if (animate) {
+         card.style.transition = 'all 0.8s cubic-bezier(0.2, 0.8, 0.2, 1)'

+       }
+ 
+       card.style.transform = &#96;translateY(${translateY}px) translateZ(${translateZ}px) translateX(${translateX}px) scale(${scale})&#96;
+       card.style.opacity = Math.max(0.4, opacity).toString()
+       card.style.zIndex = (totalCards - Math.abs(distance)).toString()
+ 
+       // Update active state
+       if (index === activeIndex) {

+         card.classList.remove('active')

+     }
+   }
+ 
+   // Navigate to previous card
+   const navigatePrev = () =&gt; {
+     if (isAnimating) return
+ 
+     // If at first card, go to last card
+     if (activeIndex === 0) {
+       setActiveIndex(cardData.length - 1)
+     } else {
+       setActiveIndex((prevIndex) =&gt; prevIndex - 1)
+     }
+   }
+ 
+   // Navigate to next card
+   const navigateNext = () =&gt; {

+   // Handle volume change

+   }

+   useEffect(() =&gt; {
+     updateCards()
+     // eslint-disable-next-line react-hooks/exhaustive-deps

+ 
+   // Initial setup
+   useEffect(() =&gt; {
+     // Initialize cards position
+     updateCards(false)
+ 
+     // Set initial music track and volume
+     if (audioRef.current) {
+       audioRef.current.src = cardData[activeIndex].music
+       audioRef.current.volume = currentVolume
+ 
+       // Add timeupdate event listener for progress tracking
+       audioRef.current.addEventListener('timeupdate', updateProgress)

+   }, [])
+ 
+   return (
+     &lt;div

+           &lt;div className='absolute left-0 right-0 bottom-[30%] border-b border-[rgba(255,255,255,0.1)] transform [transform:rotateX(60deg)_translateZ(-100px)] shadow-[0_0_20px_rgba(255,255,255,0.1)]'&gt;&lt;/div&gt;
+         &lt;/div&gt;
+ 
+         {/* Holographic elements */}
```

```diff
+   }
+ 
+   // Set music track based on active card
+   const setMusicTrack = (index: number) =&gt; {
+     const wasPlaying = isPlaying
+ 
+     if (audioRef.current) {
+       // Update music source
+       audioRef.current.src = cardData[index].music
+ 
+       // If it was playing before, start playing the new track

+         audioRef.current

+           .then(() =&gt; {

+             setIsPlaying(false)
+           })
+       }
+     }
+   }

+         translateX = 0

+           opacity = 1 - 0.15 * Math.abs(distance)
```

```diff
+ 
+   useEffect(() =&gt; {
+     if (isInitializedRef.current) return
+     isInitializedRef.current = true

+       console.error('GSAP library not found! Please check your imports.')
+       return
+     }
+

+     const initializeHUD = () =&gt; {
+       const terminalWindow = document.querySelector('.terminal-window')
+       const terminalLines = document.querySelectorAll('.terminal-line')
+       const progressFill = document.querySelector('.progress-fill')
+ 
+       // Show the HUD info panel
+       setTimeout(() =&gt; {
+         const hudInfo = document.querySelector('.hud-info')
+         if (hudInfo) hudInfo.classList.add('opacity-100')
+       }, 1000)
+ 
+       // Fill the progress bar
+       setTimeout(() =&gt; {
+         if (progressFill) progressFill.classList.add('w-full')
+       }, 1500)
+ 
+       // Show the terminal window
+       setTimeout(() =&gt; {
+         if (terminalWindow) terminalWindow.classList.add('opacity-100')
+         animateTerminalText()
+       }, 2000)
+ 
+       // Animate the wireframe and orbital elements
+       animateWireframe()
+     }
+ 
+     // Function to animate terminal text
+     const animateTerminalText = () =&gt; {
+       const terminalLines = document.querySelectorAll('.terminal-line')
+ 
+       // Make all lines visible with a staggered delay
+       terminalLines.forEach((line, index) =&gt; {
+         setTimeout(() =&gt; {
+           line.classList.add('opacity-100', 'visible')
+         }, index * 100) // 100ms delay between each line
+       })
+     }
+ 
+     // Function to animate the wireframe
+     const animateWireframe = () =&gt; {
+       // Simple animation for the globe outline
+       gsap.to('.globe-outline', {
+         opacity: 1,
+         duration: 1.5,
+         ease: 'power2.inOut',
+       })
+ 
+       // Animate wireframe lines
+       const wireframeLines = document.querySelectorAll('.wireframe-line')
+       wireframeLines.forEach((line, index) =&gt; {
+         gsap.to(line, {
+           opacity: 1,
+           strokeWidth: 0.5,
+           duration: 0.5,
+           delay: 0.1 * index, // Staggered delay
+           ease: 'power1.inOut',
+         })
+       })
+ 
+       // Animate satellites

+         scale: 1.2,
+         duration: 2,

+         yoyo: true,
+         ease: 'sine.inOut',
+       })
+

+         duration: 3,
+         repeat: -1,
+         yoyo: true,
+         ease: 'sine.inOut',
+         stagger: 0.5,
+       })
+ 
+       // Animate the central system with a breathing effect
+       gsap.to('.central-system', {
+         scale: 1.05,
+         duration: 5,
+         repeat: -1,
+         yoyo: true,
+         ease: 'sine.inOut',
+         transformOrigin: 'center center',
+       })
+ 
+       // Animate connection lines
+       const connectionLines = document.querySelectorAll('.connection-line')
+       connectionLines.forEach((line, index) =&gt; {
+         gsap.fromTo(
+           line,
+           {opacity: 0, strokeDashoffset: 300},
+           {
+             opacity: 0.2,
+             strokeDashoffset: 0,
+             duration: 2,
+             delay: 3 + index * 0.5,
+             ease: 'power2.inOut',
+           }
+         )
+       })
+     }
+ 
+     // Add a click event to make the interface interactive

+       // Create a ripple effect on click
+       const centralSystem = document.querySelector('.central-system')
+       if (centralSystem) {
+         gsap.to(centralSystem, {
+           scale: 1.1,
+           duration: 0.3,
+           onComplete: () =&gt; {
+             gsap.to(centralSystem, {
+               scale: 1,
+               duration: 0.5,
+             })
+           },
+         })
+       }
+     }
+

+     initializeHUD()
+

+

+     }
```

```diff
+ import {useEffect, useRef} from 'react'
+ import gsap from 'gsap'
+ 
+ interface CirclesHud2Props {
+   className?: string
+   colorScheme?: 'blue' | 'green' | 'purple'
+ }
+ 
+ const CirclesHud2 = ({className = '', colorScheme = 'blue'}: CirclesHud2Props) =&gt; {
+   const isInitializedRef = useRef(false)
+ 
+   // Get the primary and secondary colors based on the selected scheme
+   const getPrimaryColor = () =&gt; {
+     switch (colorScheme) {
+       case 'blue':
+         return 'rgba(0, 150, 255, 0.8)'
+       case 'green':
+         return 'rgba(0, 255, 150, 0.8)'
+       case 'purple':
+         return 'rgba(150, 0, 255, 0.8)'
+       default:
+         return 'rgba(0, 150, 255, 0.8)'
+     }
+   }
+ 
+   const getSecondaryColor = () =&gt; {
+     switch (colorScheme) {
+       case 'blue':
+         return 'rgba(0, 200, 255, 0.4)'
+       case 'green':
+         return 'rgba(0, 255, 200, 0.4)'
+       case 'purple':
+         return 'rgba(200, 0, 255, 0.4)'
+       default:
+         return 'rgba(0, 200, 255, 0.4)'
+     }
+   }
+ 
+   useEffect(() =&gt; {
+     if (isInitializedRef.current) return
+     isInitializedRef.current = true
+ 
+     // Make sure GSAP is loaded
+     if (typeof gsap === 'undefined') {
+       console.error('GSAP library not found! Please check your imports.')
+       return
+     }
+ 
+     // Apply color scheme to elements
+     const primaryColor = getPrimaryColor()
+     const secondaryColor = getSecondaryColor()
+ 
+     // Apply colors to elements
+     const satelliteElements = document.querySelectorAll('.satellite')
+     satelliteElements.forEach((el) =&gt; {
+       el.setAttribute('fill', primaryColor)
+       el.setAttribute('stroke', primaryColor)
+     })
+ 
+     const nodeElements = document.querySelectorAll('.node-3d-1, .node-3d-2, .node-3d-3, .node-3d-4')
+     nodeElements.forEach((el) =&gt; {
+       el.setAttribute('fill', primaryColor)
+     })
+ 
+     const wireLinesElements = document.querySelectorAll('.wireframe-line')
+     wireLinesElements.forEach((el) =&gt; {
+       el.setAttribute('stroke', secondaryColor)
+     })
+ 
+     // Initialize the HUD
+     const initializeHUD = () =&gt; {
+       const terminalWindow = document.querySelector('.terminal-window')
+       const terminalLines = document.querySelectorAll('.terminal-line')
+       const progressFill = document.querySelector('.progress-fill')
+ 
+       // Show the HUD info panel
+       setTimeout(() =&gt; {
+         const hudInfo = document.querySelector('.hud-info')
+         if (hudInfo) hudInfo.classList.add('opacity-100')
+       }, 1000)
+ 
+       // Fill the progress bar
+       setTimeout(() =&gt; {
+         if (progressFill) progressFill.classList.add('w-full')
+       }, 1500)
+ 
+       // Show the terminal window
+       setTimeout(() =&gt; {
+         if (terminalWindow) terminalWindow.classList.add('opacity-100')
+         animateTerminalText()
+       }, 2000)
+ 
+       // Animate the wireframe and orbital elements
+       animateWireframe()
+     }
+ 
+     // Function to animate terminal text
+     const animateTerminalText = () =&gt; {
+       const terminalLines = document.querySelectorAll('.terminal-line')
+ 
+       // Make all lines visible with a staggered delay
+       terminalLines.forEach((line, index) =&gt; {
+         setTimeout(() =&gt; {
+           line.classList.add('opacity-100', 'visible')
+         }, index * 150) // Increased delay for variation
+       })
+     }
+ 
+     // Function to animate the wireframe
+     const animateWireframe = () =&gt; {
+       // Simple animation for the globe outline
+       gsap.to('.globe-outline', {
+         opacity: 1,
+         duration: 1.8, // Longer duration for variation
+         ease: 'elastic.out(1, 0.5)', // Different easing for variation
+       })
+ 
+       // Animate wireframe lines
+       const wireframeLines = document.querySelectorAll('.wireframe-line')
+       wireframeLines.forEach((line, index) =&gt; {
+         gsap.to(line, {
+           opacity: 1,
+           strokeWidth: 1, // Thicker stroke for variation
+           duration: 0.7, // Longer duration
+           delay: 0.15 * index, // More delay between lines
+           ease: 'back.out(1.5)', // Different easing
+         })
+       })
+ 
+       // Animate satellites
+       gsap.to('.satellite-3d-1, .satellite-3d-2', {
+         scale: 1.5, // Larger scale for variation
+         duration: 3, // Longer duration
+         repeat: -1,
+         yoyo: true,
+         ease: 'sine.inOut',
+       })
+ 
+       // Animate nodes
+       gsap.to('.node-3d-1, .node-3d-2, .node-3d-3, .node-3d-4', {
+         scale: 2, // Larger scale for variation
+         duration: 4, // Longer duration
+         repeat: -1,
+         yoyo: true,
+         ease: 'sine.inOut',
+         stagger: 0.8, // More stagger time
+       })
+ 
+       // Animate the central system with a breathing effect
+       gsap.to('.central-system', {
+         scale: 1.08, // More scaling for variation
+         duration: 6, // Longer duration
+         repeat: -1,
+         yoyo: true,
+         ease: 'sine.inOut',
+         transformOrigin: 'center center',
+       })
+ 
+       // Animate connection lines with pulsing opacity
+       const connectionLines = document.querySelectorAll('.connection-line')
+       connectionLines.forEach((line, index) =&gt; {
+         // Initial animation
+         gsap.fromTo(
+           line,
+           {opacity: 0, strokeDashoffset: 300},
+           {
+             opacity: 0.3, // More opacity
+             strokeDashoffset: 0,
+             duration: 2,
+             delay: 3 + index * 0.5,
+             ease: 'power2.inOut',
+             onComplete: () =&gt; {
+               // Add a pulsing opacity animation after the initial one
+               gsap.to(line, {
+                 opacity: 0.7,
+                 duration: 1.5,
+                 repeat: -1,
+                 yoyo: true,
+                 ease: 'sine.inOut',
+               })
+             },
+           }
+         )
+       })
+     }
+ 
+     // Add a click event to make the interface interactive
+     const handleClick = () =&gt; {
+       // Create a ripple effect on click
+       const centralSystem = document.querySelector('.central-system')
+       if (centralSystem) {
+         gsap.to(centralSystem, {
+           scale: 1.15, // More scale for variation
+           duration: 0.4, // Longer duration
+           onComplete: () =&gt; {
+             gsap.to(centralSystem, {
+               scale: 1,
+               duration: 0.7, // Longer duration
+               ease: 'elastic.out(1, 0.3)', // Elastic easing for variation
+             })
+           },
+         })
+       }
+ 
+       // Flash the radar scan elements on click
+       const radarScans = document.querySelectorAll('.radar-scan')
+       radarScans.forEach((scan) =&gt; {
+         gsap.to(scan, {
+           opacity: 0.8,
+           strokeWidth: 2,
+           duration: 0.3,
+           yoyo: true,
+           repeat: 3,
+           ease: 'steps(2)',
+         })
+       })
+     }
+ 
+     // Initialize the HUD
+     initializeHUD()
+ 
+     // Add click event listener
+     document.addEventListener('click', handleClick)
+ 
+     // Cleanup event listener on component unmount
+     return () =&gt; {
+       document.removeEventListener('click', handleClick)
+     }
+   }, [colorScheme])
```

```diff
+ const SpaceCard = ({
+   className = '',
+   cards = defaultCardData,
+   initialActiveIndex = 0,
+ }: SpaceCardProps) =&gt; {
+   // State for the component
+   const [activeIndex, setActiveIndex] = useState(initialActiveIndex)
+   const [isAnimating, setIsAnimating] = useState(false)
+   const [isPlaying, setIsPlaying] = useState(false)
+   const [isMuted, setIsMuted] = useState(false)
+   const [currentVolume, setCurrentVolume] = useState(0.8)
+   const [currentTime, setCurrentTime] = useState('00:00 / 00:00')
+   const [progressPercent, setProgressPercent] = useState(0)
+ 
+   // Refs
+   const audioRef = useRef&lt;HTMLAudioElement&gt;(null)
+   const cardsContainerRef = useRef&lt;HTMLDivElement&gt;(null)
+   const progressInterval = useRef&lt;NodeJS.Timeout | null&gt;(null)
+ 
+   // Format time from seconds to MM:SS
+   const formatTime = (seconds: number) =&gt; {
+     const mins = Math.floor(seconds / 60)
+     const secs = Math.floor(seconds % 60)
+     return &#96;${mins.toString().padStart(2, '0')}:${secs.toString().padStart(2, '0')}&#96;
+   }
+ 
+   // Update player time and progress
+   const updatePlayerProgress = () =&gt; {
+     if (audioRef.current) {
+       const currentSeconds = audioRef.current.currentTime
+       const totalSeconds = audioRef.current.duration || 0
+       const percent = (currentSeconds / totalSeconds) * 100
+ 
+       setCurrentTime(&#96;${formatTime(currentSeconds)} / ${formatTime(totalSeconds)}&#96;)
+       setProgressPercent(percent)
+     }
+   }
+ 
+   // Set up music track based on active card
+   const setMusicTrack = (index: number) =&gt; {
+     if (!audioRef.current) return
+ 
+     const wasPlaying = isPlaying
+ 
+     // Update music source
+     audioRef.current.src = cards[index].music
+ 
+     // If it was playing before, start playing the new track
+     if (wasPlaying) {
+       audioRef.current.play().catch((error) =&gt; console.error('Error playing audio:', error))
+       setIsPlaying(true)
+     }
+   }
+ 
+   // Navigate to the previous card
+   const navigatePrev = () =&gt; {
+     if (isAnimating) return
+ 
+     if (activeIndex &gt; 0) {
+       setIsAnimating(true)
+       setActiveIndex((prevIndex) =&gt; prevIndex - 1)
+     }
+   }
+ 
+   // Navigate to the next card
+   const navigateNext = () =&gt; {
+     if (isAnimating) return
+ 
+     if (activeIndex &lt; cards.length - 1) {
+       setIsAnimating(true)
+       setActiveIndex((prevIndex) =&gt; prevIndex + 1)
+     }
+   }
+ 
+   // Toggle play/pause for the audio
+   const togglePlay = () =&gt; {
+     if (!audioRef.current) return
+ 
+     if (isPlaying) {
+       audioRef.current.pause()
+     } else {
+       audioRef.current.play().catch((error) =&gt; console.error('Error playing audio:', error))
+     }
+ 
+     setIsPlaying(!isPlaying)
+   }
+ 
+   // Toggle mute
+   const toggleMute = () =&gt; {
+     if (!audioRef.current) return
+ 
+     audioRef.current.muted = !isMuted
+     setIsMuted(!isMuted)
+   }
+ 
+   // Change volume
+   const handleVolumeChange = (e: React.ChangeEvent&lt;HTMLInputElement&gt;) =&gt; {
+     if (!audioRef.current) return
+ 
+     const volume = Number(e.target.value) / 100
+     audioRef.current.volume = volume
+     setCurrentVolume(volume)
+ 
+     // If changing from 0 or to 0, update mute state
+     if (volume === 0 &amp;&amp; !isMuted) {
+       setIsMuted(true)
+     } else if (volume &gt; 0 &amp;&amp; isMuted) {
+       setIsMuted(false)
+       audioRef.current.muted = false
+     }
+   }
+ 
+   // Handle click on progress bar to seek
+   const handleProgressClick = (e: React.MouseEvent&lt;HTMLDivElement&gt;) =&gt; {
+     if (!audioRef.current) return
+ 
+     const progressBar = e.currentTarget
+     const rect = progressBar.getBoundingClientRect()
+     const clickPosition = e.clientX - rect.left
+     const percent = clickPosition / rect.width
+ 
+     audioRef.current.currentTime = percent * audioRef.current.duration
+     updatePlayerProgress()
+   }
+ 
+   // Handle keyboard navigation
+   const handleKeyDown = (e: React.KeyboardEvent) =&gt; {
+     switch (e.key) {
+       case 'ArrowLeft':
+         navigatePrev()
+         break
+       case 'ArrowRight':
+         navigateNext()
+         break
+       case ' ':
+         togglePlay()
+         e.preventDefault()
+         break
+     }
+   }
+ 
+   // Effect to set up initial music track and handle cleanup
+   useEffect(() =&gt; {

+     if (audioRef.current) {

+       audioRef.current.volume = currentVolume
+     }
+ 
+     // Set up interval for progress updates
+     progressInterval.current = setInterval(updatePlayerProgress, 1000)
+ 
+     // Cleanup function
+     return () =&gt; {

+       }
+     }
+   }, [])
+ 
+   // Effect to update when active index changes
+   useEffect(() =&gt; {
+     // Update music track when active index changes

+ 
+     // Reset animation after transition completes

+       setIsAnimating(false)
+     }, 800)
+ 
+     return () =&gt; clearTimeout(timeoutId)
+   }, [activeIndex])
+

+     }

+     }
+ 
+     return () =&gt; {

+       }
+     }
+   }, [])

+         &lt;div className='absolute left-0 right-0 bottom-[30%] border-b border-white/10 shadow-[0_0_20px_rgba(255,255,255,0.1)] transform rotateX-60 -translate-z-[100px]'&gt;&lt;/div&gt;
+         &lt;div className='absolute top-[30%] bottom-0 left-1/2 border-l border-white/10 shadow-[0_0_20px_rgba(255,255,255,0.1)] transform rotateX-60 -translate-z-[100px]'&gt;&lt;/div&gt;
```
